name: tradingview-mcp
description: Codex-ready MCP bridge for TradingView Desktop via Chrome DevTools Protocol

scripts.tvStatus: node -e "const url='http://127.0.0.1:3000/health'; const wait=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); (async()=>{let lastErr; for(let i=0;i<10;i++){try{const res=await fetch(url); if(!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+res.status); console.log(await res.text()); return;}catch(err){lastErr=err; await wait(500);}} console.error(lastErr?.message || 'tvStatus failed'); process.exit(1);})()"
scripts.tvSetup: npm run tvLaunch && npm run tvBuild && npm run tvUp && npm run tvStatus
